commands.start: Hi! I'm an open source GPT bot created to provide quick help on your questions.
commands.start_end: Just send me a message, and I'll try to help!
commands.start_group: In a group, mention me (@%s), reply to my message or use /ask <question>.
commands.help: Available commands: /ask <question> - Ask a question (works in groups; reply with /ask to a message to ask about it) /reset - Clear conversation history /reset <new prompt> - Set a new system prompt /reset system - Reset system prompt to default /stop - Stop the active request /help - Show this help message In groups the bot answers to commands, @mentions, its short names and replies to its messages. Advice: before asking about a new topic, use /reset so the old context is not sent: answers will be more accurate and faster.
commands.help_admin: Admin commands: /model - Show the current model /set_model - Choose a model with buttons /set_model <model id> - Set a model /set_model default - Return to the model from config /get_models - List free models /get_models <text> - Search all models with prices /stats - Usage statistics
